note: Every slot checkride knows is named here, so this file, not detection, says what runs. A slot set to false has no tool in this repo: format (no formatter is used), prose (no vale), mutation (no stryker config), publint and attw (not installed), unclaimed (no targets are declared) and schema (no schemas are declared). A slot with optIn runs only under --include or --all. unclaimed.ignore names a test fixture that holds a go.mod: it is data the readers are tested on, not code of this repo, so no target claims it.

intent.description: keyframes.md, the project's intent, checked strictly
intent.note: keyframes.md is the current statement of what atis is for and what must hold (D345 (intent-in-keyframes)). The check reads only: it follows every citation and every held-by pointer into the repo, so a renamed test or a deleted rule that held a constraint turns this red. --strict fails on warnings too, budgets among them.
